object_context: Whole-space Type-I Navier-Stokes blow-up-classification child for Clay statement (A). Bind the exact scaling and producer/consumer interfaces for Grujic arXiv:2607.08866v2: whether the logarithmically weighted vorticity-direction bmo condition is stable under parabolic zoom-in, and which separate amplitude/far-field/pre-singularity hypotheses still block transfer from the Albritton-Barker finite-I class. This is a source/interface audit, not a new regularity theorem; Type-II is outside this atom.
structural_coordinates: unforced whole-space 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes with viscosity normalized to 1
parabolic zoom x=x0+r y, t=t0+r^2 s with 0<r<=1; vorticity direction is dimensionless wherever vorticity is nonzero
Grujic v2 defines bmo_phi with phi(rho)=1/|log rho|, an L-infinity term, and a supremum over all centers and 0<rho<1/2
Grujic Definition 2.1 additionally assumes a critical-point profile omega=Phi|x|^-2 with scale-invariant or log-periodic core shape and |grad Phi| controlled at critical order
Grujic Theorem 7.4 assumes uniform-in-time critical concentration, in particular global spatial L^{3/2,infinity} vorticity, plus uniform-in-time bmo_phi direction regularity
the localized commutator proof separates near field from far field; the far-field estimate invokes the global L^{3/2,infinity} vorticity norm
Albritton-Barker finite I and its local compactness do not supply the normalized-vorticity bmo condition or the global critical vorticity profile
merged NS-B1a3b already falsifies topology-only inheritance of a direction modulus through one derivative plus normalization; this child does not retry that family
merged NS-B1a3 records global-tail/profile-leakage and local-to-global interface failures; they are reused only where the Grujic far-field signature genuinely matches
Grujic Theorem 7.4 is a pre-singularity regularity criterion for a unique spatially analytic solution near a first possible singular time, not an ancient-solution Liouville theorem
backward uniqueness is not needed if the source theorem applies directly and cannot manufacture its missing geometry or global vorticity concentration
